notes: CWE-400 DoS via STARTTLS on Postgres; clean patch release v3.6.8; Go leaf binary, small rebuild blast radius.

CWE-119 memory corruption in py/runtime.c mp_import_all. REHARVEST 2026-05-26: original row had upstream_tag_or_release=v1.27.0 (last_affected). Actual nixpkgs fix is a fetchpatch overlay on 1.27.0, NOT a version bump. Fix commit 570744d06c5ba9dba59b4c3f432ca4f0abd396b6 (PR #18671, merged ~2026-01-12); nixpkgs adds it as fetchpatch on commit 3f880d9f (Feb 8, 2026) on top of the 1.26->1.27 bump (74fe65b1). nixpkgs_rev=74fe65b1 is pre-fetchpatch state (micropython 1.27.0 without CVE fix). patch_shape=patches-overlay. upstream_tag_or_release=v1.28.0 is the upstream release that contains the fix (needs verification at bootstrap). PoC: mp_import_all triggered by 'from fake_nonmodule import *' with a non-module object in sys.modules; sandbox-viable with micropython CLI binary.
Public dashboards annotation time-range bypass; access-control bug; clean patch release; Go binary, leaf.
CWE-89 SQL injection in QuerySet.annotate/alias/aggregate/Q; django patch release 4.2.25; mapping medium because nixpkgs attr path is python3Packages.django_4 vs upstream CPE django:django.

CWE-1287 oidvector memory disclosure; clean patch release 14.20->14.21 with 4 co-fixed CVEs in release notes; upstream-ref itself is eligible, but bundle.kind goes to human-review-required because reverse-closure exceeds v0 blast-radius threshold (500). kind_reason: blast-radius-exceeds-threshold.

CWE-125/787 OOB r/w in RFC 3211 KEK unwrap; clean 3.0.17->3.0.18 patch release on the LTS line; upstream-ref eligible but blast-radius > 5000 (openssl is a transitive dep of almost everything) forces human-review-required. kind_reason: blast-radius-exceeds-threshold.

CWE-416 UAF via Lua scripting leading to RCE (plus 3 co-fixed CVEs). Multi-release 8.0.3->8.2.2 (two minor bumps); compounded by the post-SSPL-relicensing context making this branch a contentious choice for many distros. human_review_trigger: ambiguous-changelog / large-sbom-delta.

CWE-142 SMTP client crash on malformed 334 response. The nixpkgs attr fetchmail_7 was previously pinned at an unstable-2022-05-26 snapshot; fix required jumping to a 7.0.0-alpha11 release. Large delta from multi-year snapshot to alpha, zero passthru.tests. human_review_trigger: ambiguous-changelog.

CWE-416/119 UAF+heap overflow in Atomics Ops Handler. nixpkgs maintainer applied upstream commits directly because 'no new release is available yet' at fix time — classic cherry-pick, out of v0 scope. mapping_difficulty medium because of quickjs vs quickjs-ng disambiguation.

CWE-119 memory corruption in objdump debug_type_samep. nixpkgs backported as a local .diff file rather than bumping binutils; v0 forbids cherry-picks. Toolchain rebuild blast radius is huge (>5000), contentious to land even once a patch release IS available.

Xen Security Advisory XSA-475 covering CVE-2025-58147 (and -58148): incorrect input sanitisation in Viridian hypercalls causing OOB r/w. Applied as patch in nixpkgs — cherry-pick. Hypervisor security tends to be contentious because reviewers want to trace the full fix.

CWE-407 algorithmic-complexity DoS via crafted JSON in bundled mjson. nixpkgs cherry-picked the upstream commit rather than waiting for a patch release. Leaf app, routine decision — cherry-pick is the only thing making this advisory-only in v0.

CWE-73 path-traversal in tar hardlink handling (co-fixed with CVE-2026-26158). nixpkgs backported upstream fix rather than bumping — cherry-pick. Busybox is in the initrd/bootstrap paths so the closure is large.
CWE-122/119 heap overflow in scope_new in the mruby compiler codegen. Applied as a patch rather than version bump. Small leaf package, routine decision bar the cherry-pick gate.

CWE-674 uncontrolled recursion in URL parser. Upstream 0.9.9 -> 1.0.0 is a 0->1 major jump (project marked the 1.0 release as the stable line); per §2a, major-version-jumps force human review. human_review_trigger: major-version-jump. Canonical input-triggered crash, straightforward reproducer.
CWE-125/119 OOB read in CSMLoader. Upstream 5.4.3 -> 6.0.2 is a major jump with 3 co-fixed CVEs. Canonical malformed-file reproducer. human_review_trigger: major-version-jump.

CWE-416 UAF in MediaTrackGraphImpl (one of 9 CVEs co-fixed in Thunderbird 144.0.1). Mozilla bumps major versions every release cycle, so 143->144 is routine-but-major. mapping_difficulty ambiguous: nixpkgs has thunderbird, thunderbird-unwrapped, thunderbird-bin, thunderbird-bin-unwrapped, thunderbird-latest-unwrapped, thunderbird-140-unwrapped — multiple plausible target attrs for the same upstream CPE. Impractical reproducer: UAF in media stack requires specific rendering context.

CWE-22 path traversal via tarfile realpath overflow. nixpkgs added a 2055-line CVE-2025-4517.patch to cpython 3.14 rather than bumping — cherry-pick. mapping_difficulty ambiguous: nixpkgs pins python310, python311, python312, python313, python314 as separate attrs, all affected by overlapping CVE windows. Canonical tarfile PoC, straightforward reproducer. version_bump_complexity classified per INCLUSION_RULES.md axis-clarification: the qualifying upstream release path would be a python 3.14.x patch-release.

CWE-476 NULL pointer dereference in SubtableUnicodesCache::create during font parsing. nixpkgs applied upstream patch rather than bumping — cherry-pick. Canonical malformed-font PoC (straightforward). harfbuzz is a huge transitive dep (gtk, qt, pango, cairo, ...) so contentious decision.

CWE-121 classic stack-based buffer overflow in rofl0r/proxychains-ng <= 4.17. Cherry-pick — maintainer applied upstream patch without version bump. Small leaf binary; reproducible with a crafted DNS hostname.
CWE-787 out-of-bounds write in pdftoras (PDF-to-raster). Cherry-pick as patches in nixpkgs. Co-fixed with CVE-2025-57812. Printer filter library used by CUPS toolchain; moderate closure.

CWE-306 missing authentication in grub CLI — allows access to encrypted device once the root device is unlocked. Cherry-pick. Bootloader patches are kernel-adjacent (pre-kernel environment) and contentious because grub testing requires a boot simulation loop.

CWE-159 improper handling of invalid characters; openssh 10.1p1 release. mapping_difficulty ambiguous: nixpkgs has openssh, openssh_gssapi, openssh_hpn — all three variants are affected by the same upstream openssh CPE. openssh_gssapi is a variant attr so its own reverse closure is small; the 'main' openssh is much larger but that's a separate attr. Clean point-release with security fix callout.

CWE-416 UAF (one of a typical Chromium security-update batch). Clean patch release 141.0.7390.76->141.0.7390.107. Browser UAFs are impractical reproducers — they need a full renderer process plus specific navigation. Leaf app, small reverse closure.

CWE-295 JRuby-OpenSSL hostname verification disabled by default. Patch release 10.0.0.0 -> 10.0.2.0. mapping medium: CPE 'jruby:jruby' overlaps with generic 'ruby' references in some advisory databases. TLS verification is config-sensitive.

CWE-908 vfs_streams_xattr uninitialized memory write (co-fixed with CVE-2025-10230). Samba 4.22.3->4.22.5 point release. Config-sensitive: triggering the uninit write requires specific share/stream configuration.

CWE-80/250/79 RCE via Jupyter Proxy. Calendar-versioned 2025.12.0 -> 2026.1.1, effectively two minor bumps. Reproducer is impractical — requires distributed cluster with Jupyter proxy enabled. mapping medium: upstream is dask/distributed, nixpkgs attr is python3Packages.distributed. human_review_trigger: ambiguous-changelog / large-sbom-delta.
CWE-203 constant-time / side-channel issue on Xtensa ESP32 (one of 8 co-fixed CVEs in 5.8.2 -> 5.8.4). Multi-release bump (skipped 5.8.3) triggers human-review for ambiguous-changelog/large-delta.

CWE-121 stack-based buffer overflow in gnutls_pkcs11_token_init(). Clean 3.8.10->3.8.11 patch release. Upstream-ref eligible; bundle.kind goes to human-review-required via blast-radius-exceeds-threshold (gnutls is a transitive dep of a wide set of applications).

CWE-787 buffer underrun in pkwrite when writing an opaque key pair (CWE source: NVD direct; Vulnpatch had no CWE at harvest time). Clean mbedtls 3.6.1 -> 3.6.2 patch release. Small/moderate closure. Classification crypto-shaped confirmed by the fix being in the PK-serialization path.

CWE-364 signal-handler race in systemd-coredump letting a local attacker crash+exploit core capture. Clean 257.5->257.6 patch release with 8 cited upstream commits; upstream-ref eligible; bundle.kind flipped to human-review-required via blast-radius-exceeds-threshold (systemd is installed everywhere).

CWE-415 double-free. Upstream glibc rolled out as a batch of 76 patch-level increments (2.40-66 to 2.40-142) containing the CVE fix alongside unrelated backports. Classified kernel-adjacent because glibc sits directly under every process on the system. Triggers human-review on both blast-radius (>5000) AND ambiguous-changelog (large collection of co-landing patches).

CWE-121 stack buffer overflow in xmllint interactive shell. nixpkgs applied as a patch (cherry-pick) against the pinned libxml2_13 attr. mapping medium: nixpkgs has both libxml2 (current) and libxml2_13 (legacy 2.13.x line) separately; CVE and CPE map to multiple attrs. Huge closure (libxml2 is a foundational dep).

CWE-770 uncontrolled resource consumption. Clean 2.7.1->2.7.2 patch release. Upstream-ref eligible; bundle.kind human-review-required via blast-radius-exceeds-threshold. expat is a widespread XML parser dep (used by glib, python, perl, xmltooling, ...).

CWE-125 OOB read in png_image_read_composite. Clean 1.6.51->1.6.52 patch release, canonical image-parser fix. Upstream-ref eligible; bundle.kind human-review-required via blast-radius-exceeds-threshold.

WebSocket endless loop (DoS). Clean curl 8.14.0->8.14.1 patch release. mapping medium because nixpkgs has both curl and curlMinimal as variant attrs (curl is the larger default-features build); the CVE applies to upstream curl so the mapping to the minimal variant requires judgment.
CWE-617 reachable assertion in named — malformed BRID/HHIT records crash the server (DoS). Clean 9.20.17->9.20.18 patch release; bind is a leaf service, small reverse closure.

CWE-125 information leak via getimagesize (one of 4 co-fixed CVEs in PHP 8.4.16). mapping medium because nixpkgs pins php (current), php82, php83, php84 as separate attrs, all affected by overlapping advisory windows. Large closure; bundle.kind human-review-required via blast-radius-exceeds-threshold.

CWE-125 worker process memory disclosure via ngx_mail_smtp_module 'none' auth method. nginxMainline 1.27.5 -> 1.29.1 crosses multiple minor versions (commit body notes the bump was previously reverted in another PR before re-landing). mapping medium: nginx vs nginxMainline vs nginxQuic variants. human_review_trigger: ambiguous-changelog.

CWE-787 stack-based buffer overflow in asn1_expend_octet_string (CWE source: NVD direct; Vulnpatch had no CWE at harvest time). Point-release 4.20.0 -> 4.21.0. Classification crypto-shaped defended by libtasn1's role as the ASN.1 encoder under gnutls/libksba certificate handling; parser-heavy was also defensible but crypto-shaped captures the containing crypto stack.
CWE-20 unauthenticated persistent DoS via array injection in adminer. Clean 5.4.1->5.4.2 patch release. Leaf PHP web UI.
CWE-863 improper authorization in Discourse AI continue-conversation (one of 4 co-fixed CVEs in 2025.12.1). Calendar-versioned patch release. Ruby forum app, leaf.
CWE-266 privilege escalation via unix domain socket forwardings. Clean 2025.88->2025.89 patch release. Small C SSH server used in embedded/alternative installs.

CWE-362/416 race + UAF in RDPGFX ResetGraphics (SDL client) — one of 8 co-fixed CVEs in 3.20.0->3.20.2. Small delta within a single minor series. Impractical reproducer: RDP session UAF requires full client context.
CWE-276 insufficient validation of incoming notifies over TCP, leading to DoS. Clean 5.2.6->5.2.7 patch release. DNS recursor, leaf service.
CWE-22 arbitrary file write via metalink path traversal (co-fixed with CVE-2025-69195). Canonical path-traversal PoC, straightforward reproducer. Clean 2.2.0->2.2.1 patch release.
CWE-426 untrusted search path in auth_query connection. Point-release 1.24.1->1.25.1. PostgreSQL connection pooler, leaf service.
CWE-59 arbitrary file write via crafted symlinks in Git LFS. Clean 3.7.0->3.7.1 patch release. Go binary, leaf tool. Symlink-attack PoC is straightforward.
CWE-280 insufficient permission check in AdminServer Snapshot/Restore. Clean 3.9.3->3.9.4 patch release. Java distributed-coordination service, leaf.

CWE-1333 ReDoS in ETag header value generation. Point-release 4.1.1->4.2.1. mapping medium because the nixpkgs attr path is rubyPackages.sinatra vs upstream CPE sinatra:sinatra. Ruby web framework, small reverse closure within nixpkgs.

CWE-41 improper regex path matching (one of 3 co-fixed CVEs in 5.0.1 -> 6.0.0). Major-jump from 5.x to 6.x. mapping medium: nixpkgs has flask-cors under multiple pythonNNPackages variants; upstream CPE flask-cors:flask-cors. config-sensitive because the bug manifests in how CORS path prefixes are configured and matched. Added as a spare major-jump candidate so the ≥3 composition rule has slack above threshold.

CWE-191 integer underflow -> stack buffer underwrite in depack_pha() (Pha Packer .mod file loader). Fix 004a102c5a bounds-checks the ocpt iterator. parser-heavy: trigger requires crafted .mod file with overflowed ocpt value; upstream ships test fixtures (test-dev/data/f/prowizard_pha_invalid_ocpt). Phase 2 sandbox-positive target: binary-format parser crash without ASM fuzz dependency. Small audio/tracker library, <50 reverse closure in nixpkgs. PATCH COMPLEXITY NOTE (2026-05-24): nixpkgs 4.6.2->4.6.3 is a complete package rewrite, not a simple version bump. The nixpkgs maintainer (marcin-serwin) rewrote the package to use fetchFromGitHub (instead of fetchurl+sourceforge), CMake/Ninja (instead of autotools), MIT license (instead of LGPL2.1+), and added multiple outputs (out/dev/man) + nix-update-script. patch_shape updated to package-rewrite. The fetchFromGitHub hash sha256-VTjS5bVu+jiswP4GCTxcAdhtVdtopy4A3hxlzIQlZVU= is manually pinned in the bundle's upstream-ref.json. Patcher will need to produce a comprehensive diff; interesting test of non-trivial version-bump scope.
